limitations: The Town labels these grants PAID; this is source-reported historical payment information, not independently verified bank settlement, invoices, or an audited transaction ledger.
The source labels the period 2024-25. Exact start and end dates are not stated and are not inferred from retrieval time or PDF creation metadata.
The dollar symbol is explicit, but an ISO currency code, cash-versus-accrual basis, tax treatment and treatment of in-kind amounts are not stated in the grants-paid PDF.
Organization is the source column heading. Some rows identify programs, events or abbreviated organizations rather than verified legal recipients. No names are corrected, expanded or entity-matched.
Document/page/data-row locators and local hash IDs are not official grant, supplier, transaction, council-motion or legal-entity identifiers.
The separately captured policy is general program context, not proof of approval of these individual amounts. It excludes some grant types; its applicability to every listed row is not established.

The stated total is a source total, separately reconciled to the 36 displayed detail rows with exact decimal arithmetic. It is not an additional payment and does not establish complete municipal expenditure coverage.
No Halifax expenditure allocation, current-year status, cross-year trend, recipient score, service outcome, irregularity or decision-to-payment join is inferred.
Only source-attributed factual values are projected. The original PDF, page image, HTML, headers, contacts, capture journals and policy text remain private; no broad reuse licence is asserted.
